name: node
title: Board node
description: Anything the agent draws on the board, as one generic element whatever its type (D-015). Every node carries its actions on its edges, where the board's skin puts them (D-099, D-100; skins.ts SKIN_DEFS): the number is the Bookmark toggle, the answer (a disc, or a Tick | Cross switch) answers a node that asks, the change badge opens its history, the notes mark opens its conversation; right-click or a long press lists the six actions with their keys. No footer. An app node is a window (node-window.ts). ✓ and ✗ are tools with no meaning of their own (D-045): lit, the answer in its state colour is the whole state.

files.core: node-core.ts (nodeState, nodeLabel, offers, isPressed, proposalsView, handoverView; no DOM); node-notes.ts (conversation, replyEntry, litReplies: a card's notes and replies as one conversation; no DOM); node-time.ts (noteTime, versionTime, fullTime: a time in the person's clock; no DOM); node-updates.ts (updatesView: a changed card's badge words and stepper; no DOM); node-app.ts (appView, APP_CARD_STATES, APPS_OFF: an app card's state view, D-047; no DOM); node-marks.ts (nodeMarks, toneView, MARK_KEYS, HISTORY_KEY: what the marks on the node's edges show; no DOM)
files.template: node-template.ts (nodeTemplate: the only place the markup is built); node-edges.ts (edgesMarkup: the node with its marks on its edges, or in a plate with the answer as a switch, by the skin's row); node-window.ts (windowMarkup: an app node as a window); node-menus.ts (numberMenu, answerPicker, contextMenu, menuId: the node's three fixed-size menus, as markup for ../menu/menu-template.ts)
files.icons: node-icons.ts (KIND_ICON per kind, ACTION_ICON's close and comment, svgIcon); ../icons/icon-set.ts (ICONS, MARK_ICONS: every built-in and mark drawing as path data) and ../icons/icon.ts (icon, iconPaths, iconLibrary: a built-in, or a library icon from the checked paths the page passes in, else nothing: the plain tile); ../skins.ts (SKIN_DEFS: where each skin puts the answer and the marks)
files.behaviour: node-popover.ts (POPOVER_SHOW, POPOVER_OPEN, POPOVER_HIDE, POPOVER_CLOSE: the events of a box beside the node, which the page opens from its marks); node-app-apply.ts (applyApp, applyPanelSize, applyWindow, bindAppNameTip, keepingDrawer, renderKeepingPanel: an app window applied in place, its name's tip, its drawer; browser only); node-history.ts (historyBox, historyMarkup: the history box and its rows; the page fills it as it shows); paused/paused.ts (pauseControls: a locked board's controls aria-disabled in place, shared with the region pattern; browser only); node-edges-apply.ts (applyMarks, applyTone: the marks state and the tone applied in place, the tone through CSSOM; browser only)
files.styles: node.css (scoped by the tag; tokens only: the card, its tabs and its content); node-popover.css (the box beside the node and the proposals and history rows in it); tip/tip.css (the shared hover tip's box); node-steps.css (a changed card's step section and stepper, in the history box); node-parking.css (the handover section); node-app.css (an app window: its bar, the panel edge to edge, the state views, the app's status and its menu, the drawer, on stage); paused/paused.css (a control paused while its board is locked, shared with the region pattern); node-edges.css (the marks on the node's edges); node-plate.css (a skin row's plate along the top and Tick | Cross switch along the bottom, data-marks-at='plate' and data-answer-at='switch': the Command Lens skin, FE_04); ../icons/icons.css (the icon set's one stroke); ../menu/menu-fixed.css (the fixed-size menu and the answer picker); node-box.css (the box beside a node: the conversation, proposal and history boxes' one look, last in #ui/styles.css)

parts.vb-node-num: the number (items only), a mark on the top border, left: the Bookmark toggle (vb-mark, data-mark number); in a plate, its first mark
parts.vb-node-kind: the kind tab on the top border, centred: the kind, with grip dots; the drag handle, the one place a card is moved from (3_FE_01); in a plate, the kind's word with its dot or the node's icon
parts.vb-node-content: title (vb-node-title; with an icon, vb-node-head), body (div.vb-node-body, Markdown through renderMarkdown), tags as chips (vb-node-tags), the handover section
parts.vb-node-steps: items only (FE_02): the step section at the top of the history box (planner's call 9) (role region, aria-live polite, named 'Update 2 of 3, v5'), shown while the stepper is open: the version, when and who (vb-step-head), the change chips (vb-step-chips, each li with data-change added | changed | removed: '+ body', '~ title', '- tags'), what the text gained (vb-step-line: the new title, the added body, or 'Body rewritten'); past the last step 'You're up to date' (vb-step-done), which fades
parts.vb-app-status: app windows only (card-polish FE_01, FE_08): in the window's bar, after why Allow shows. One control at most, applied by update(): Allow (vb-pop-btn vb-pop-primary, data-app-act="app-allow", named 'Allow app: Calculator. Not allowed yet' or '… Code changed', the reason its title) in needs-approval and changed; 'Allowed ▾' (vb-pop-btn vb-app-allowed, data-app-menu, aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded, aria-controls, named 'App allowed: Calculator') once the person allowed this version; nothing otherwise. Its menu (vb-menu-list vb-app-menu, role=menu, the board's menu look, opening under the bar) holds one menuitem, Stop app (data-app-act="app-revoke", named 'Stop app: Calculator'). Loading: aria-busy on the control while its act is in flight; error: data-error once refused, until the next press. Hidden at far zoom, keeping its room
parts.vb-app: app cards only, in place of the Markdown body (ruling 3): the slot, the panel's size (--vb-app-w, --vb-app-h) in every state, edge to edge under the window's bar, data-app-state one of APP_CARD_STATES, aria-busy while checking; it holds the frame (<vb-app-frame>, shown in needs-approval, changed and ready; unloaded by update() in any other state) and the state view (vb-app-state, over the frame otherwise): the app's icon or, invalid or broken, the warning one (vb-app-icon), a line in bold (vb-app-head: 'App calculator not found', 'This app has problems', 'This app stopped', the app's title on a past version), a line under it (vb-app-text), the problems (vb-app-problems, a mono list that scrolls and is a tab stop, labelled Problems) and Check again (missing, invalid) or Restart (vb-pop-btn, data-app-act="retry")
parts.vb-node-stepnav: items only (FE_02): the stepper under the step section in the history box: 'Update 2 of 3' (vb-node-stepcount), Back (data-step="back", aria-disabled on the first step) and Next (data-step="next"), the box's buttons (vb-pop-btn)
parts.vb-card-pop: items only: a box beside the node (div.vb-tip.vb-card-pop.vb-node-box, role dialog, data-pop its name, the id its mark's aria-controls names), placed by the page's placeBeside (top level with the node, right or below, the arrow on the mark; node-box.css) and shown while data-open is on it. The proposal box (the disc, or the plate's proposal chip) holds one group per proposal, newest first (vb-prop, data-proposal = its seq, data-stale when out of date): who (vb-prop-head), what (vb-prop-what), from where and when (vb-prop-from), why it is out of date (vb-prop-why), then Reject and Accept (vb-pop-btn with data-proposal and data-answer; Accept aria-disabled and described by the reason when out of date). The history box (the badge, H, right-click; tabindex 0, since it scrolls) is 'History of N' with an × (data-box-close), the stepper, then one row per entry (vb-history-row: its version, ↩ for a proposal withdrawn; its words; who and when), a row naming a note or a reply a button (data-history-note, data-history-reply) in the link colour; empty, 'Nothing has happened to this card yet'.
parts.vb-mark: A mark on the node's edge, each a real button named by its state (data-mark): `number` (vb-node-num, the Bookmark toggle, aria-pressed; bookmarked it fills and grows a notched tail), `answer` (vb-mark-answer, the disc top right: data-answer waiting | ticked | crossed, data-proposed ack | drop for a proposal's dashed ring; aria-haspopup menu: the answer picker), `badge` (vb-mark-badge bottom left, data-badge new | updates | settled; it controls the history box, which holds the stepper), `notes` (vb-mark-notes bottom right, data-notes-mark none | count | unread, data-group for a note on several nodes), and vb-mark-awaiting (quiet text, no control); with the `switch` answer, `tick` and `cross` halves. The page sets data-saving, data-failed and data-locked on a pressed mark for a moment.
parts.vb-node-grip: the drag handle of a node with an icon, in the middle of its top line (no kind tab)
parts.vb-node-tile: the icon in a 40px tile at the right of the body (vb-node-head, vb-node-heading, vb-node-kick: the kind's word over the title, grey on a node that only tells); empty, the plain tile, for a library name missing or failing its check
parts.vb-node-edge: the bottom edge's row: the badge, Awaiting, and the notes mark on the disc's vertical line
parts.vb-node-handover: a written handover as a section of the node's body, under its 'Handover' heading
parts.vb-node-plate: a skin row with marks: 'plate' (Command Lens, FE_04): the plate along the top, the drag handle, holding the number, the kind (vb-node-kind with vb-node-kind-word, the kind's dot or the node's icon in its place), the badge, Awaiting, the proposal chip and the notes mark; dark on a node that asks, light on one that only tells
parts.vb-mark-switch: a skin row with answer: 'switch' (Command Lens, FE_04): Tick | Cross along the bottom of a node that asks, two halves (vb-mark-half, data-mark tick and cross), each a toggle named 'Tick item N (A)', aria-pressed while lit; pressing the lit half clears the answer; data-proposed outlines the proposed half
parts.vb-mark-proposal: a skin row with answer: 'switch': the plate's 'Proposal' chip (data-mark proposal), shown while a proposal is open, named 'Proposal on item N, the agent proposes tick'; it controls the proposal box
parts.vb-win-bar: app window: the window's title bar, a plate (vb-node-plate): number, name, badge, reason, app status, drawer arrow, Open
parts.vb-win-name: app window: the app's icon and name, cut with '…', whole in its tip (vb-app-name-tip)
parts.vb-win-reason: app window: why Allow shows ('Not allowed yet', 'Code changed'), beside it: a lock and its words, on a window under 480px the lock alone with its words in its tip (data-tip) and for a screen reader, so the app's name keeps the room; hidden otherwise
parts.vb-win-btn: app window: the drawer arrow (data-drawer, the notes count, data-notes-mark) and Open (data-app-act stage, aria-pressed while on stage)
parts.vb-win-drawer-pane: app window: the drawer, a region named 'Conversation on N', holding the node's conversation box the page docks there (notes/app-drawer.ts)

attributes.data-id: the node id; the page finds a node with closest('vb-node')
attributes.data-kind: one of KINDS; see NODE_TYPES in packages/format/src/node-types.ts. Colour comes from --vb-kind, which render() sets to var(--vb-kind-<kind>)
attributes.data-status: open | acknowledged | dropped | commented | later (set by update; an old context note reads as commented). commented is with the agent: the person's latest note waits for its answer, its name says 'Replied' (D-046; agents read with-agent). acknowledged and dropped colour only the lit answer: no word, no fade, no strike-through (D-045)
attributes.data-pinned: present when the person moved it (set by update)
attributes.data-selected: present while the person has it selected (3_FE_01; view state the page passes to nodeState, set by update): mockup 05's look, 1.5px in the card's own colour lifted about two-thirds of a step toward the strong ink (--vb-select-lift, 35%) and a little more saturated (--vb-select-chroma, 1.25: OKLCH chroma scaled; review polish round 2 ruling 5), every kind alike, with a soft glow
attributes.data-emphasis: present when the agent marked the node as emphasised (set by render)
attributes.data-size: nodeSize flag only: s | m | l, the tier from sizeTier (packages/layout), which picks the width token; set by update before the page measures
attributes.data-size-picked: nodeSize flag only: present when the person picked the size (set by update)
attributes.aria-label: number, kind, title and, on a card that asks, its status (nodeLabel, set by update: 'Open', 'checked', 'crossed', 'Replied', 'Saved for later'), then ', selected' while selected
attributes.data-bubble: present while its note bubble is open, so the card draws over its neighbours (set by the page)
attributes.data-pointer-focus: present while the card has focus that a pointer press gave it (set by the page, apps/board/src/board/canvas/pointer-focus.ts): no focus ring draws when a key that moves no focus (Z, Esc, Space) makes the browser match :focus-visible; focus the keyboard moves never carries it
attributes.data-open: on a box beside the node (vb-card-pop), while it shows (set by the page, which opens it from its mark and sets the mark's aria-expanded); the node is drawn above its neighbours meanwhile
attributes.aria-busy: on a proposal (vb-prop) while its answer is on its way (set by the page)
attributes.--vb-card-surface, --vb-card-surface-sun: wireLayers flag only (D-032): fills the page sets on the world (board.css, [data-wire-layers]) as --vb-card-fill of the card, topic and note surface over transparent, so a connector drawn behind a card shows through. node.css reads them with the solid token as fallback (--vb-surface; a note's background), so with the flag off the colours are exactly as before
attributes.data-zoom: on the stage, not the node: 'far' below FAR_K, only with the hideControlsZoomedOut flag (on by default, tracker N13): an app window's Allow and the state view's buttons hide (keeping their space); the keyboard shortcuts still work
attributes.--vb-mark-grow: D-101, FE_05: written by the page on the cards layer, 1 down to 64% zoom and stepped by 1.2 below, so an edge mark (.vb-mark, the kind tab, the grip) never draws under --vb-mark-min on screen down to the far breakpoint (about 37%; past it the growth stays and marks scale with the node, FIX_02); node-edges.css reads it as `scale`, about each mark's own centre (the number and the change badge: their left edge). A plate skin's marks are not scaled. --vb-box-scale: on a box beside a node, one rule for all three (D-104, FIX_05): drawn at clamp(zoom, 0.8, 1.2) on screen (the history and proposal box, inside the node, at that over the zoom), node-box.css
attributes.data-marks (stage): FIX_02, points 430 to 438: "small" past the far breakpoint (viewport.ts MARK_FAR_K, about 37%), where the marks stop growing and scale down with the node: a pointer press on a mark selects its node only, no hand, no hover tip; the keyboard as ever. Above it every mark takes its press.
attributes.--vb-app-w, --vb-app-h: app windows only (D-047): the panel's size in px (panelSize), set through the CSSOM by render() and update(); the window is --vb-app-w (plus the drawer while open) and its border wide, whatever its emphasis, and takes no data-size
attributes.data-app-act: on an app window's buttons: app-allow, app-revoke (the action layer's acts, person only, confirmed by the page), retry (the page reads list_apps again) or stage (Open); the page's delegated listener acts on it
attributes.data-bookmarked: present while the person bookmarked the node (set by update from BoardState.bookmarks, D-099 2): the number fills and grows a notched tail (in an app window's bar, a notch cut inside it). The person's private mark: never sent to an agent.
attributes.data-name-tip-open: app windows (card-polish FE_04): the app name's tip shows under the bar (set by bindAppNameTip; gallery samples set it to show it)
attributes.data-edges: on every node (set by render): the marks on its edges; data-answer-at (disc | switch) and data-marks-at (edges | plate) from the skin's row (render's opts.edges, else the default skin's) place them; node-plate.css styles data-marks-at='plate' and data-answer-at='switch' (never a skin's name)
attributes.data-icon: the node has an icon: a grip, a kind word and a tile in place of the kind tab
attributes.data-vb-tone, --vb-tone-h: the node's tone (decision 17), the name or `hue`, and the hue through CSSOM (the checked number, or the name's hue token)
attributes.data-window: the node is an app window (node-window.ts; an app card with the appCards flag on)
attributes.data-drawer-open: the window's drawer is open; the node is wider by --vb-drawer-w (the card's conditions carry it, so the page measures it so)
attributes.data-stage: the app window fills the page as a manual popover in the top layer (app-frame-stage.ts)

methods.update(st: NodeState): on every state change: attributes and text only (data-status, data-pinned, data-selected, data-bookmarked, aria-label, the marks' names and states from st.marks; with st.size, data-size and data-size-picked; with st.proposal, the proposal box's contents when they changed; with st.handover, the handover section; with st.updates, the step section (rebuilt only when its step changed) and the stepper's count; with st.app, the app's slot, status and window bar); so focus survives
methods.render(n: ViewNode, opts?: { appCards, i: once per view version: data-*, role, tabindex, --vb-kind, innerHTML = nodeTemplate(n, opts): the edges markup in the skin's row (opts.edges, skins.ts; the default skin's when left out), or an app window; data-edges, data-answer-at, data-marks-at, data-icon, data-window and the tone; opts.icons the project's library for an `x-` icon

events: a click on a mark ([data-mark]) bubbles to the page's delegated listener (mark-flow.ts): the number toggles Bookmark (held, its menu), the disc opens the answer picker, a switch's half answers, the badge opens the history box, the notes mark opens the conversation box; the context menu event or a long press opens the six actions
a click on a proposal's Reject or Accept (button[data-answer]) bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> the act with `proposal` (an aria-disabled Accept does nothing)

vb-popover-show (POPOVER_SHOW) on the node as a box shows, detail { name, box }: the page fills the history box; vb-popover-open (POPOVER_OPEN) once a key or click opened it, detail the box; vb-popover-hide (POPOVER_HIDE) as it hides; the page dispatches vb-popover-close (POPOVER_CLOSE) with a box's name to close it
a click on the stepper's Back and Next ([data-step]) bubbles to the page's listener (update-flow.ts) -> the step, and a card seen for each step shown

a click on an app window's data-app-act button or its "Allowed ▾" (data-app-menu) bubbles to the page's listener (app-cards.ts); the drawer arrow ([data-drawer]) opens or closes the drawer (notes/app-drawer.ts)
whenToUse: Anything the agent draws that the person should read or respond to.
whenNotToUse: Region headings and lane labels; those belong to the region pattern.
accessibility: Focusable list item with a label naming number, kind, title and, on a card that asks, its status ('checked' or 'crossed' for a lit ✓ or ✗); a selected card's label ends ', selected' (a list item takes no aria-selected), and the page announces the count in a polite live region. Selection is not focus: the focus ring still draws on a selected card. A card the keyboard focused always shows its ring; one a click focused shows none until the keyboard moves focus (data-pointer-focus). Text: the content (title, body, tags, Markdown code blocks) is selectable; the marks are not. Each mark is a real button whose name says its state ('Answer item 35, waiting for your answer (A tick, X cross)', '2 updates, history of item 4 (H)', '3 notes on item 4, agent replied (C)'); the number keeps its name ('Bookmark item 28 (B)') and aria-pressed says whether it is bookmarked; a switch's halves are toggles ('Tick item 12 (A)'); the markup is in visual order (number, kind, disc, body, badge, Awaiting, notes), so reading and Tab order follow it; the ring is the calm slate (--vb-focus-edge) and shows after Tab only; aria-keyshortcuts names the number's and the notes mark's keys; every mark has a hit area of at least 24px. Pressing a lit answer clears it, and a second press within 400 ms is ignored. Keyboard on a focused node: A X answer, C the conversation, B bookmark, L save for later, H history, Shift+F10 or the menu key its actions (on the number, the number's menu); Space adds it to the selection or takes it out; Alt+Arrows move, R resets the position. Proposals: the card's label adds ', 1 proposal' (', out of date'); the box's buttons are named 'Reject: cross 47' and 'Accept: cross 47', and an out-of-date Accept stays focusable, aria-disabled, described by its reason. Changed cards: the label adds ', 3 unseen updates' (', showing update 2 of 3' while stepping); the step section is a polite live region named for its step; Back is aria-disabled on the first step. App windows (D-047): the label adds the app's state after the title (', loading', ', not allowed yet', ', code changed, not allowed yet', ', app not found', ', app has problems', ', app stopped', ', not running in a past version'; nothing when ready) and never a status word; Allow (its name ending with its reason: 'Allow app: Calculator. Not allowed yet'), 'Allowed ▾' (a menu button, 'App allowed: Calculator', whose menu takes the board's menu keys and holds Stop app), Open, Check again and Restart are named with the app; the drawer arrow is named with the notes count and aria-expanded; the problems list is a tab stop so a keyboard can scroll it; the panel's own keyboard rules are the app-frame pattern's.

flaggedStates.paused: lockBoard (N40 ruling 4; the state shows whatever the flag, since the lock is the ledger's): on a locked board (`NodeState.paused`, from `BoardState.locked`) the answer (the disc or the switch's halves) and a proposal's Accept and Reject stay in place and in the tab order, aria-disabled and data-paused (paused/paused.ts), looking as they would at rest (point 328); a press shows a lock for a moment and the page says why. The bookmark is never paused by a lock. An out-of-date Accept stays aria-disabled once unlocked. A ledger open read-only (readOnlyStart, D-085; `BoardState.readOnly`) pauses the same controls, and the number too (`NodeState.readOnly`): read-only writes nothing, a bookmark included.
